format: NDCA eligibility dispute at the event (future NDCA body profile)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: If an eligibility dispute about a competitor's level or age category is unresolved, the Chairman refers it to the NDCA Ballroom Department for resolution after the event.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must provide a referral record for unresolved eligibility disputes and must not resolve them in-event by exclusion.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile. No DanceFlow action, status or workflow models it; the existing 'Excluded (organizer decision)' action (CF1 A5) is organizer policy and is never a substitute.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23: 'refer the dispute to the NDCA Ballroom Department for resolution, to be dealt with after the conclusion of the event'. BLOCKER for an NDCA profile.
